title: Grateful Dead Live at Boston Garden on 1977-05-07
source: Source: Betty Cantor's SBD Reel Master > PCM > Beta PCM clone > cloned to wav file on computer by Sony SLHF300 Betamax and modified Sony PCM601esd via spdif output > VX pocket SPDIF input > emphasis decoded in software and played out of computer via SPDIF out into Myteck Stereo DAC96 (balanced analog out with Superclock on) > DBX150X  Type I dbx decode (balanced analog in and out) > Korg MR2000 (1 bit) > rendered to 24 48 in Audiogate

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard captures a killer first set highlighted by a punchy U.S. Blues and an intense Terrapin excerpt.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as an “incredible source” with pristine, flowing clarity that makes the listening experience feel like a fresh mountain stream. Musically the show delivers a strong first set – “killer” according to reviewers – with a short but powerful Terrapin moment and Jerry Garcia ripping through U.S. Blues, leaving fans wishing they’d seen it live.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave high star ratings (5 and 4) and highlighted exceptional audio quality and strong performance, but only two brief reviews limit confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Described as an incredible, crystal‑clear source with no noted flaws; reviewers liken it to “drinking from a running stream.”

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set described as ‘killer’ and only gets better, with an intense Terrapin excerpt leading into strong second‑set momentum.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia “bangs out U.S. Blues” with energetic playing; praised for his tone and drive.
